A person can invoke the following GDPR articles after a chatbot gives incorrect information about them:

- Article 15 GDPR (Right of access): To request information about the personal data processed by the chatbot.
- Article 16 GDPR (Right to rectification): To request the rectification of their personal data.
- Article 17 GDPR (Right to erasure): To request the erasure of their personal data if applicable.
